description: EMBO SODA-VEC Dot/Std/Cov is a MIT-licensed sentence-transformers ModernBERT biomedical and life-science literature embedding model trained on PubMed Central title-abstract pairs with a VICReg-style dot, standard deviation, and covariance objective. The existing hidden TEI CUDA 1.9.3 Forge row has passed B200/us-central1, H200/eu-north2, and L40S/eu-north1 probes with 10 measured embedding requests each, but repeated B300/uk-south1 startup diagnostics failed with `cuda compute cap 103 is not supported`. This separate hidden fallback row reuses the already mirrored official vLLM 0.21.0 CUDA 13 image digest sha256:a230095847e93bd4df9888b33dab956fa9504537b828a23657d2b26fed57b5c9, launches it with `--runner pooling`, and selects MEAN pooling with activation enabled because the 2026-05-28T15Z TEI/vLLM parity capture showed the earlier unactivated vLLM profile was directionally equivalent but returned raw mean-pooled vectors while TEI returned unit-norm OpenAI embeddings. The Hugging Face API recheck on 2026-05-28T14Z reported the artifact public, ungated, enabled, MIT licensed, sentence-transformers based, feature-extraction tagged, revision ec602c16dd5e973d36128ba03bd430927c21754a, and safetensors-backed with 149,014,272 F32 parameters. The corrected 2026-05-28T15Z B300/uk-south1 hidden probe passed with 3 warmups and 10 measured requests, 59.820 s startup, 68 ms client-wall p50, 735.29 tokens/s, 1.21 GB VRAM, and normalized TEI/vLLM parity over 10 synthetic non-PHI HCLS retrieval texts: min cosine 0.9999929217, mean TEI norm 1.0000000005, mean vLLM norm 0.9999999968, max norm delta 0.0000000855, and max raw vector delta 0.0004001741. Keep this row hidden/onboarding/default-ineligible until HCLS product safety approval is complete.
